# FitTrack design DNA

The sidebar owns its width and the page body owns normal page scroll. Nested scroll is allowed only for bounded tables, lists, and overlays. There must be no page-level horizontal overflow. Content must shrink within flex and grid parents. Purpose and state precede controls. Empty content collapses instead of preserving decorative dead space. Responsive behavior follows the available container and the user's job, not only the global viewport. Operational pages use restrained radii, deliberate hierarchy, point-of-need disclosure, and compact action groups. Do not treat one happy screenshot as coverage. Every relevant role, viewport, fixture, state, and overlay requires fresh evidence. Modals require visible geometry, a clear scroll owner, close behavior, focus return, tab containment, inert background, and a non-destructive cancellation path.

# FitTrack admin web profile

Admin pages follow route to provider or hook to page frame to focused operational surfaces to modal to responsive state. Directories combine context with a bounded table or list and use an inspector, drawer, or modal for details. Toolbars group search, filters, view controls, and actions. Tables own their horizontal overflow. Destructive or consequential mutations require explicit confirmation.

# Mechanical UI enforcement

Before source mutation, compile a context-bound UI run contract, page-design contract, component-composition contract, and browser QA request. A valid run must include visual and responsive evidence, a boundary state, a negative state, a resilience state, and every declared overlay. Completion requires static validation, browser evidence, objective geometry and overflow checks, and independent judgment. Repair attempts are bounded.

# Modal and drawer contract

Use a modal for a consequential decision that interrupts the current task. Keep the message specific, preserve a visible cancel action, ensure keyboard closure and focus return, and keep long content inside an explicit bounded scroll owner.

# Pagination and continuation

Use pagination for stable administrative records when location and bounded retrieval matter. Show result position, disable impossible transitions, preserve filters, and test the first, empty, and boundary states.

# Application Reference Atlas — task-scoped extract

Reuse proven behaviors, not brand costumes. Framer contributes plan-before-mutation,
local-pattern reuse, deterministic geometry/lint, rendered pixels, independent
judgment, and reversible repair. Lovable contributes explicit plan/review/build
separation and maintained design-system context. Notion contributes one data source
with task-specific views and progressive disclosure. Linear contributes coherent,
recoverable actions and minimal creation. Figma contributes contextual controls and
constrained component variants. Attio contributes scope → view → filter → select →
inspect/act for directories. Vercel and Railway contribute staged consequential
changes, visible state, and inspectable evidence.

For FitTrack, compose Attio + Notion for operational directories and views; Linear
for action consistency; Figma + Lovable for constrained component variants and
explicit design context; Railway + Vercel for staged changes and evidence; Framer
for plan → bounded change → geometry/lint → pixels → independent judgment →
repair/rollback. Repository tokens, approved FitTrack DNA, role jobs, and runtime
evidence remain authoritative.

# Framer-Like Agent Orchestration Model — task-scoped extract

Classify intent; load only relevant manuals and project context; inspect established
layouts, styles, colors, and components; form a design plan; apply bounded patches;
measure geometry; run hard rules for layout, type, contrast, and accessibility;
render actual pixels; use independent model judgment; analyze failed sessions; rerun
evaluation; and keep work reversible.

Broskie maps this to: thin workflow routing; vault-loaded standards; project pack
and repository component inventory; a locked design-decision deliverable; scoped
repository edits; Playwright geometry and screenshots; Python validators; an
independent critic that receives evidence instead of the implementer's PASS claim;
and bounded repair. Context selection is derived from project, role, route, task
class, affected components/states, risk, required tools, and knowledge gaps. A valid
vertical slice declares its state/viewport matrix, design references, baseline,
bounded plan, deterministic checks, candidate pixels, independent criticism, repair,
and reusable correction record.

# Tabs and View Switchers Contract — task-scoped extract

Tabs switch among peer panels in one context. Quiet operational interfaces keep
peer geometry stable across selected and unselected states. Equal workspace tabs
retain equal width and height. Selection may use a restrained underline plus
brand-colored text or icon emphasis, but not a broad tinted fill that makes one
peer appear larger or heavier than the others.

Mechanical evidence captures each peer's rectangle, aria-selected state, computed
background, bottom-border indicator, and font weight. Reject unequal peer geometry,
zero-or-multiple selected peers, broad filled selection, hidden-panel interaction,
stale panel content, clipped labels, and unreachable narrow-width peers.
